name: Artifact Registry
description: Implement a registry for generated artifacts: build outputs, type definitions, schemas, documentation, and any file produced by a tool or command. Each artifact entry includes its path, type, provenance metadata (generator, timestamp, source), content hash, and lifecycle status. The registry supports query, invalidation, and garbage collection.
purpose: Generated artifacts are a primary source of workspace complexity — they consume disk space, go stale, and confuse analysis. A central registry tracks every artifact's identity and provenance, enabling intelligent cache invalidation, rebuild detection, and cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: Artifact registry stores entries with path, type, content hash, generator identity, generation timestamp, and source identity
Registry supports query by path, type, generator, source, and time range
Registry supports invalidation: mark artifacts as stale when source changes
Registry supports garbage collection: remove artifacts that are stale and unreferenced
Artifact entry lifecycle: created, valid, stale, orphaned, deleted
Registry is queryable via API and CLI
Artifact provenance chain is traceable: artifact → generator → source commit → workspace state
